findings.detail: The flagged Azul Systems row is a comparative-period version retained into the 2024-06-30 holdings even though the current-period schedule has a separate Azul row.

rationale: PP03 is a row-disposition issue. The source contains a current-period Azul Systems row at table 16 row 21 with interest rate 9.98% and a separate comparative-period Azul Systems row at table 25 row 19 with interest rate 10.04%. The flagged artifact describes a source period earlier than the 2024-06-30 report date retained as a comparative-period fact, so the defect is the comparative row leaking into the current holdings rather than a missing current source position.
